description: Adds a history of a wall value. A history is a table of floating point values assigned by sampling a model attribute periodically during a simulation. The history can be assigned a name for later reference with the optional name keyword, if not the history will be given a default name based on its internally assigned id number. Following one of the keywords given below, either 1) an additional 'id' keyword followed by an integer id, 2) an additional 'name' keyword followed by a string s, or 3) an additional 'position' keyword followed by a position vector v must be given to define the specific wall. Quantities that can be recorded include position, velocity, displacement, spin, euler, force-contact, and moment-contact. Live 9.7: the quantity slot was fully enumerated (Batch P1); an object selector (id <i> or position <v>) is REQUIRED after the quantity - omitting it fails with 'No object for history specified'.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('wall history ...') - Python SDK does not provide history recording. Use history commands for manipulation

6.0: Live 6.00 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity.
7.0: Live 7.0 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity (same grammar as 9.x).

The selector is 'id <i>' or 'position <v>' (or 'name <s>'); 'index <i>' (one component of a vector quantity) and 'log' parse after the quantity on live 7.00 and 9.8; 'magnitude', 'vector' and a separate component token (e.g. 'stress zz') are rejected - use the per-component keywords.
9.0: Live 9.7 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity. The selector is 'id <i>' or 'position <v>' (or 'name <s>').

'[wallhistoryblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where a modifier may follow the quantity. 'index <i>' (one component of a vector quantity) and 'log' parse after the quantity on live 7.00 and 9.8; 'magnitude', 'vector' and a separate component token (e.g. 'stress zz') are rejected - use the per-component keywords.

syntax.6.0: wall history [name <sid>] keyword id <id> or name <s> or position <v>
